# Flap Disc

Flap disc for angle grinders that combines grinding and finishing in one step on welds, edges and flat surfaces.

- SKU: AK-FD-SAMPLE
- Category: Flap Discs
- Web page: https://arsen-industrial.com/products/flap-disc/

## Specifications

- Diameter: TBD (e.g. 100 / 115 / 125 mm)
- Abrasive: TBD (zirconia / ceramic / aluminium oxide)
- Grit: TBD (e.g. 40–120)
- Backing: TBD (fibreglass / plastic)
- Shape: TBD (Type 27 flat / Type 29 conical)
- Max RPM: TBD

## Applications

- grinding
- blending

## Details

Flap discs use overlapping abrasive flaps bonded to a backing plate. As the
flaps wear, fresh grain is exposed, giving consistent cutting through the life
of the disc.

**Sample content — replace with your real product description and specifications.**

## FAQ

**Q: What is the difference between Type 27 and Type 29?**
A: Type 27 is flat and suits finishing on flat surfaces. Type 29 is conical and gives more aggressive stock removal on edges and welds.

# Non-Woven Abrasive Wheel

Non-woven nylon abrasive wheel for deburring, blending and satin finishing on stainless steel, aluminium and other metals.

- SKU: AK-NW-SAMPLE
- Category: Non-Woven Wheels & Discs
- Web page: https://arsen-industrial.com/products/non-woven-abrasive-wheel/

## Specifications

- Diameter: TBD (e.g. 150 mm)
- Width: TBD
- Bore: TBD
- Grit / grade: TBD (e.g. Coarse / Medium / Fine)
- Max RPM: TBD
- Materials: Stainless steel, aluminium, copper, plastics

## Applications

- deburring
- blending
- cleaning
- finishing

## Details

Non-woven abrasive wheels combine nylon fibre with abrasive grain in an open,
flexible structure. The wheel conforms to the workpiece surface, so it gives a
uniform finish without gouging and runs cooler than bonded grinding wheels.

**Sample content — replace with your real product description and specifications.**

## FAQ

**Q: Can this wheel be made in custom sizes?**
A: Yes. Diameter, width, bore and grade can be customised under our OEM/ODM service. Contact us with your drawing or target specification.

**Q: Does it change the dimensions of the part?**
A: Non-woven abrasives remove very little material, so they are suited to finishing and light deburring rather than heavy stock removal.

# Pneumatic Die Grinder

Compact air-powered die grinder for deburring, porting and finishing in tight spaces, compatible with mounted points and small abrasive wheels.

- SKU: AK-PG-SAMPLE
- Category: Pneumatic Tools
- Web page: https://arsen-industrial.com/products/pneumatic-die-grinder/

- Air pressure: TBD (e.g. 6.2 bar / 90 psi)
- Air inlet: TBD
- Weight: TBD

## Applications

- grinding
- deburring
- finishing

## Details

Pneumatic die grinders are light, run cool and tolerate continuous duty better
than many electric tools, which makes them common in fabrication and mould
shops.

# About Arsen Kogyo

Arsen Kogyo (富士達商貿) is a trading and manufacturing partner based in Taiwan,
specialising in grinding consumables and pneumatic tools.

We serve two kinds of customers:

- **Workshops and professionals** buying ready-made tools through our online store.
- **Brands, distributors and manufacturers** who need OEM/ODM products made to specification.

# OEM / ODM Manufacturing

We manufacture abrasive wheels, grinding consumables and pneumatic tools under
your brand or to your specification.

## What we can customise

- Size, grit, grade and abrasive material
- Packaging, labels and private branding
- Product development from a drawing, sample or target performance

## How it works

1. **Send your requirement** — drawing, sample, or the problem you need to solve.
2. **Specification and quotation** — we confirm materials, tolerances, MOQ and lead time.
3. **Sample approval** — you test samples before mass production.
4. **Production and shipping** — inspection before shipment, with documents for your supply chain.

## Supplier documents

We can prepare supplier qualification documents for buyers entering
electronics and industrial supply chains.
